shellCommands.command: for f in index.html src/*.tsx src/*.ts tsconfig.json vite.config.ts .gitignore; do echo "=== $f"; cat $f; done; ls __agent_eval__

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit && ls build/esm/components/theme/ && cat build/esm/components/theme/ThemeProvider.d.ts build/esm/components/theme/ThemeProvider.js build/esm/components/theme/types.d.ts build/esm/components/theme/index.d.ts; ls build/esm/components/SegmentedRadioGroup 2>/dev/null | head

cat build/esm/components/SegmentedRadioGroup/SegmentedRadioGroup.d.ts | head -40; grep -n "SegmentedRadioGroup\|ThemeProvider\|useThemeValue" build/esm/index.d.ts build/esm/components/index.d.ts | head

cd /home/sandbox/workspace && python3 - <<'EOF'
p='src/main.tsx'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace("import { ThemeProvider } from '@gravity-ui/uikit';\n\nimport { App } from './App';","import { App } from './App';\nimport { PersistentThemeProvider } from './theme';")
s=s.replace('<ThemeProvider theme="light">','<PersistentThemeProvider>').replace('</ThemeProvider>','</PersistentThemeProvider>')
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF
cat src/main.tsx; npm run build 2>&1 | tail -15
npm run build 2>&1 | tail -6; rm -rf dist; ls node_modules | grep -i -E "jsdom|happy-dom|testing-library|playwright"
